scope: Existing Zhuang and Standard Moroccan Tamazight assignments: complete wording for controls and notices. Working language review, not shipped resources.
terminology_notes: Zhuang background colour uses the existing Saek baihlaeng. Commons attribution labels remain distinct from licence and author.
Tamazight uses the existing assembly name ⴰⵙⵎⵓⵏ ⵏ ⵜⵡⵍⴰⴼⵉⵏ and the existing image noun, as opposed to the competing draft assembly term. Metadata means file information rather than image data.
holds: Do not promote Zhuang custom-versus-selected colours, canvas drag versus pan, or clipped thumbnail language mechanically.
Do not promote the Tamazight missing attachment wording until it identifies the anchor image rather than its dependent.
